scaleBeatText: With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Stonebridge's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.
A sequence of foods on the table. Eat them in the right order.

Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
